easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Yannik until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
